comment: The maker's own second line on every CV input reads 'CV is clipped to the range 0-5V, fully open at 5V', and on the channel 6 output 'Mix of channels 1-6'; both hold. The level is the knob times the CV over 5, clamped to 0-1, so the CV attenuates the knob and cannot open a channel the knob has closed. The mix skips any channel whose own output is patched (src/Ceres.cpp:55-57), which is not documented anywhere in the maker's text. The inputs cascade like Asset's.
